positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
* Architected and built a full-stack, Dockerized SaaS platform that transforms PDF forms into AI-driven voice conversations, deploying a scalable and secure AWS infrastructure using S3, CloudFront, ECR, EC2 Auto Scaling, VPC, IAM, and CloudFormation.

* Designed and implemented event-driven AWS Lambda functions, one handling Stripe subscription and payment Webhooks and another converting uploaded PDF forms into conversational voice flows using OpenAI APIs.

* Built and deployed the production React.js web app, an iOS app built with React Native and Expo, Python FastAPI backends, PostgreSQL database with row-level security, and CI/CD pipelines using AWS Secrets Manager for secure, automated deployments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mandiant Data Science Engineering
* Optimized a Java-based Mandiant CROS threat-intelligence microservice running on Kubernetes in AWS, using Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to improve scalability and deployment reliability.
* Built Java REST APIs for Mandiant Managed Defense using OAuth 2.0 and JWT-based authentication to ensure secure, compliant access to malware samples and threat statistics.

SecLM Cloud Billing Integration
* Developed Go-based logic for Google Cloud Billing integration, streamlining SecLM API monetization and access to advanced threat detection tools.

Google Search DPR Data Governance
* Created a Java gRPC application and scalable Flume-based pipelines to enhance Google Search data governance, ensuring compliance and improving decision-making.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python (Programming Language) · Go (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Shell Scripting · Bash · Kubernetes · Apache Flume · Cloud Pub/Sub · Agile Development

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected Scala and Apache Spark ETL pipelines on Databricks to process millions of autopay records during new client onboarding.
* Developed Scala services and AWS Lambda–backed APIs to orchestrate Databricks Spark jobs for migrating and reconciling autopay records across systems.
* Implemented Spark-driven data validation and synchronization rules in Databricks to ensure highly accurate, compliant account and payment data.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · AWS APIs · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Data Pipelines · Cross-team Collaboration · Apache Spark
